goal.title: Release v1.3.0: Modular Spec Extensions, CEP-0002 Media Provenance, and Native MCP Ergonomics
goal.intent: Deliver major v1.3.0 milestone consolidating Track 24 (spec extensions / crystal comms), CEP-0002 (media provenance), and Track 25 (MCP consolidation & TDQS optimization)

acceptanceCriteria.description: Track 25: Consolidate MCP tools to uniform verb_noun and promote eager lifecycle registrations [task-1]
Track 24: Implement Modular Spec Extensions Architecture under .ccrystals/<id>/extensions/ [task-2]
CEP-0002: Implement Media & Multi-Modal Provenance extension metadata schemas and verification [task-3]
Synchronize agent harnesses and distribute updated skill across agents [task-4]
Run multi-platform test matrices and tag release v1.3.0 [task-5]
Implement Modular Extension Embedded Skills: manifest skill field, CLI ext skill, comms/sample_runner skills, and agent harness discovery
Implement DAG Node Inspection & Querying (ccrystal node list/show, hydrate --all, MCP crystal_hydrate/search scoping) and codify Dogfooding & Raw Bypass Reflection Invariant in AGENTS.md
Review latest automated media post-production pipeline patterns for potential CEP-0002 media provenance spec refinements
Close storage CRUD lifecycle completeness gaps: implement artifact unregistration/deletion symmetry and task cancellation/removal

nodes.contentSummary: Initialized crystal 'release-v1-3-0-extensions-media-and-mcp-optimization' with goal: Release v1.3.0: Modular Spec Extensions, CEP-0002 Media Provenance, and Native MCP Ergonomics
Track 25 complete: Implemented first-class crystal_lesson tool, self-hydrating task and checkpoint responses, and deployed instructions.md

Implemented comms DAG reflection: added --record-dag flag to CLI comms send and record_dag parameter to crystal_extension_comms and crystal_extension_call, automatically recording causal DAG nodes (human_prompt for humans, agent_reasoning for agents) with comms_message_id metadata
Expanded Track 24 scope with task-6: Implement Modular Extension Embedded Skills (manifest skill field, CLI ext skill, comms and sample_runner companion skills, and agent harness discovery)

Completed task-6: Implemented Modular Extension Embedded Skills with ExtensionManifest skill field, FsCrystalStore SKILL.md auto-detection and resolution across scopes, BuiltInExtensions commsSkillMarkdown, sample_runner reference SKILL.md, CLI ext skill command, and crystal_extension_call dynamic skill dispatch

Track 24 Comms Hygiene & Extension Metrics complete: Implemented mailbox ack, clear, and FIFO limit, aligned routing to distinguish groups from topic channels, and added zero-telemetry Extension Metrics & Overview to stats dashboard. Verified across JVM and Native with 100% green tests.

Completed Conductor track dag_node_inspection_and_hydration_ergonomics_20261021 and task-7: implemented DAG node query engine, ccrystal node list/show, ccrystal hydrate --all, crystal_hydrate(all=true), crystal_search(crystal_id=...), and codified dogfooding invariant in AGENTS.md

Completed task-8 (CEP-0002 Hyperframes declarative motion, trilingual subtitles, broadcast loudness) and task-9 (storage CRUD lifecycle completeness: artifact unregistration and task cancellation symmetry across core, CLI, and native MCP). Verified across JVM, Native, and JS with 100% green test suite (833 tests) and installed updated binary.
